details: teick@1.0.2 ships no code: the tarball contains only package.json (118 bytes), and its sole content of consequence is a preinstall lifecycle hook running `curl hxxps://159[.]223[.]131[.]130:8080`. Installing the package therefore causes an immediate outbound HTTPS request to a hard-coded IP address (159[.]223[.]131[.]130) on port 8080, with the actual payload delivered from that endpoint rather than from npm — the publish is a name-reservation container whose behaviour lives entirely on the remote host. There is no bundled script, decoder or second stage inside the package, so the package functions purely as an install-time trigger/callback to the operator's server. IOC: hxxps://159[.]223[.]131[.]130:8080.
